crossRefs.note: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your…
There you shall eat before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your…
I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of…
It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

translations.web: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.
translations.bsb: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
translations.kjv: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
translations.asv: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto thee: I will give thanks unto thy name, O Jehovah, for it is good.
